# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_FLIP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After the morning session, a shift to a lower high (BOS) while price is below VWAP signals short‑term bearish momentum. This captures intraday mean reversion after morning exhaustion, particularly in choppy, non-trending regimes where VWAP acts as a dynamic equilibrium.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: After 11:00 ET, if price makes a lower high than the prior swing high and closes below that prior low (BOS) while price is below the VWAP, enter short at the close of the bar that creates the lower high. Exit shape: Stop at the recent swing high (prior higher high); TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 10% off HWM. Regime hint: Effective when VIX is moderate (15‑25) and the day is not strongly trending (price oscillating around VWAP); avoid the first and last 30 minutes.
